summary: Skyworks Solutions completed its previously announced merger with Qorvo on October 5, 2026, following the October 27, 2025 merger agreement. Each Qorvo share converted into 0.960 Skyworks shares plus $32.50 cash, a mixed stock-and-cash structure. Qorvo became a wholly owned Skyworks subsidiary via a two-step merger, with the surviving entity merged into a Skyworks LLC. The 8-K also discloses management changes, other events, and financial statements. Deal terms imply significant integration risk and potential regulatory overhang, with deal-arb focus on synergy realization and post-close ownership split.
